locations.name: Courtyard
locations.description: Broken flagstones ring a dry fountain.

locations.name: Great Hall
locations.ambient: A cold draft moves the banners
locations.description: A long table, its chairs pushed back as if everyone left at once.

locations.name: Library
locations.description: Shelves sag under books nobody has opened in years.

locations.name: Cellar
locations.description: Barrels and a cracked western wall of loose stones.

locations.name: Crypt
locations.description: Stone coffins in a low vault.

objects.name: dusty shelf
objects.description: A long shelf thick with dust.

objects.name: ancient map
objects.description: A brittle map of the keep with a passage marked beneath the cellar.

trace_on_take.cue: A clean rectangle interrupts the dust on the shelf, as if something lay there until recently.

objects.name: lantern
objects.description: An iron lantern with a little oil left.

objects.name: crypt door
objects.description: A low iron-bound door behind the loose stones.

objects.name: brass key
objects.description: A small brass key, green with age.

secret_facts.claim: Mira carries the brass key to the crypt door and knows the passage behind the cellar's western wall.

sounds.hidden_source: A loose iron grate in the crypt shifting in the draft.
